result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder, with the full 1280px screen inside `#component`. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Content:** It has the "Approvals" heading and the "3 waiting for you" line. It also has the three approval items, each with its title, requester, amount, an Approve button and a Decline button.
- **Design rules:** I followed `DESIGN.md` for the colors, type scale, spacing, 16px card radius and pill buttons. Approve is the primary button and Decline is the quiet one. Hover transitions use the specified curve and 180ms timing.
- **Extra text:** I added small "Requester" and "Amount" labels on each card so the fields are named. That is slightly more than your exact content, so remove them if you want nothing extra.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo are named in the CSS, but nothing in the folder loads them. Without them installed, the browser will use fallback fonts.
- **Button labels:** Each button has an `aria-label` that includes its item title, for example "Approve Q4 travel budget". Screen readers will read those instead of the bare "Approve".
